# Conformance

Generated by `cargo xtask conformance`; never edit by hand. Each value of `oracle/expected/` (NCA against PKNCA), `oracle/expected/models/` (closed-form model values; `pk2/` and `pk3/`: two- and three-compartment values, partial derivatives and the inputs the engine must refuse) and `oracle/expected/fit/` (reference weighted least-squares fits) is compared with the engine within the tolerance named for its kind below; a value expected as not available must be not available. For the fits, the entries of the per-case tables are the groups of the oracle tests (estimates, residual sum of squares, statistics, confidence limits, information criteria, secondary parameters) and the convergence status. A value covered by a documented difference (`specs/differences.md`) is neither validated nor a failure: it has its own column and is left out of the totals. A value held by an open question of `board/QUESTIONS.md` is the same: it is listed as held, and left out of the totals. The floors (last lines: validated, expected, documented and, when there are any, held rows per parameter per case) can only go up.

**Overall: 96662 of 96662 values validated (100.0 %).** 16 further values are documented differences, neither validated nor failures. 108 further values are held by an open question (column `held`), neither validated nor failures. 294 further values are on free-zone cases that the engine refused (column `refused`), neither validated nor failures.

294 values on 3 cases are free-zone rows (zone (0) or (iii) of MOD-3C-08, `oracle/expected/models/pk3/`, options kind `model_macro_free`) whose macro input the engine refused with `DegenerateExponents`. The spec leaves the engine free to refuse them, and the oracle test `check_free` accepts the refusal, so they are not failures; there is no value to compare, so they are not validated either. They are in none of the counts above, and the case tables below list them in a `refused` column. When the engine accepts one of these inputs its rows are compared and move to the validated counts; the floors do not let them go back.
